أَمْلَطُ A man having little, or scanty, or thin, hair upon the sides of his face, or of his cheeks; like أَمْرَطُ: (S:) or having no hair upon his body, (Lth, K,) except the head and beard. (Lth.) ―
-b2- An arrow of which the feathers have fallen off; like أَمْرَطُ: (S:) or an arrow having no feathers upon it; as also ↓ مَلِيطٌ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
